title: Input Symbol in a Canonical Configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $w,u$ be Boolean words, and choose a saved configuration of $M$ on input $w$, a semantic state $q$, an integer $j$, and $i\le |w|$. The symbol under the input head in the canonical evaluation configuration at input offset $i$ is the optional $i$-th bit of $w$.
hypotheses_covered: finite Boolean machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
replaced:
In the canonical evaluation configuration at input position $i$ on input $w$, the
symbol read by the input head is the optional $i$-th entry of $w$; it does not
depend on the saved extractor bank.
